generationPrompt: Square 1:1 master for a small gameplay ability icon in a whimsical fantasy survival game. Stylized 2D storybook cutout, hand-painted but clean, thick deep-plum outer contour, flat matte colors, simple cel shading, bold readable silhouette, low detail, designed to remain unmistakable at 48 pixels. One centered emblem fills about 72% of the canvas with generous transparent padding. Genuine transparent background. No frame, no card, no panel, no scene, no ground plane, no baked shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no characters or hands, no photorealism, no 3D render, no pixel art. Six chunky violet crystal shards forming a clockwise spiral around an amber center.
